title: FSKX Model-Interchange Bundle v1.0.0
description: Language-neutral, typed serialization of FSK-ML model parameter VALUES, used to pass the OUTPUT(s) of one model run into the INPUT(s) of another (model joining/chaining). A superset of the RAKIP Parameter-JSON-Exchange-Format (parameters-schema.json): it keeps `parameters[].metadata`, `parameters[].data` and `parameters[].modelId`, but gives `data` a concrete, per-dataType encoding so any reader (R, Python 2/3, ...) can reconstruct the value without sharing a runtime. Large or binary values are spilled to sidecar files referenced by relative path; the JSON stays human-readable and diffable.

formatVersion.description: Semantic version of THIS interchange format.

generatorLanguage.description: Script language that produced the bundle (provenance only; readers are language-agnostic).

generatedBy.description: Optional provenance for the whole bundle.

runId.description: Run folder id this bundle was produced in (e.g. 20260623_101530).

parameters.description: One entry per serialized parameter value (typically the model's declared OUTPUT params, but any classification is permitted).

dataType.description: FSK-ML controlled vocabulary for parameter data types (see FSKX spec 4.3).

metadata.description: Parameter metadata. Mirrors the ModelMetadataSchema `Parameter` object; only the fields needed to interpret the value are required here.

id.description: Parameter id (must match the variable/parameter name in the model script).

modelId.description: Id of the model that produced/uses this parameter (enables multi-model bundles).

sourceVariable.description: Variable name in the generating namespace, if it differs from id.

typedValue.description: Concrete encoding of a single value. `encoding` discriminates inline (value in JSON) from ref (value in a sidecar file). `dataType` is echoed here so the value is self-describing independent of metadata.

encoding.description: inline: value carried in `value`. ref: value stored in the sidecar described by `ref`.

value.description: The inline value. Shape depends on dataType (see INTERCHANGE_SPEC.md). Non-finite numbers are encoded as null and flagged in `special` / `specials`.

shape.description: For MATRIXOFNUMBERS: [rows, cols]. For VECTOROFNUMBERS optional [length].

special.description: For a single non-finite NUMBER/INTEGER/DOUBLE whose `value` is null.

specials.description: For VECTOROFNUMBERS/MATRIXOFNUMBERS: map of flat element index (string) -> non-finite token. The corresponding array element is null.

columns.description: For a dataframe-like OBJECT serialized to a csv/parquet sidecar: maps column name -> FSK-ML dataType, preserving per-column logical types across the language boundary.

partial.description: For OBJECT: true if the object is not tabular and not fully JSON-serializable; `value`/`ref` then holds a best-effort extract and the run carries a warning.

sidecarRef.description: Pointer to a value stored in a separate file next to the bundle (relative path on the shared work volume).

path.description: Path relative to the bundle file. Must not escape the bundle directory (no leading '/' or '..').

format.description: How the sidecar is encoded. 'raw' = opaque FILE payload.

mediaType.description: IANA media type, e.g. text/csv, application/octet-stream.

header.description: For csv: whether the first row is a header. Default false for MATRIXOFNUMBERS.
